title: fhe prover
tagline: Prover network designed especially for fhe operations. Since fhe operations are quite expensive in itself to compute.
description: Enabling segmentation of fhe operations by the prover network so as to generate short proofs for the fhe operations. The project is not yet completed during the duration of hackathon but still under process. Will continue working on building this fhe prover network along the way.
